description: This file defines a PHP class ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Claim plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties and methods to filter claim expense types based on name, status, and id. The class also defines allowed sorting fields and initializes default sorting by 'expenseType.name'.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for filtering claim expense types in the OrangeHRM Claim plugin, allowing filter criteria and sorting options to be set.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'expenseType.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current filter value for 'name'.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current filter value for 'status'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the current filter value for 'id'.
